notes: The shipped CSS no longer imports fonts.googleapis.com or requests fonts.gstatic.com at runtime.
Unicode symbols and emoji use platform-provided fallback fonts and are not bundled media files.
No optional soundtrack is currently shipped; combat sounds are synthesized at runtime.
